description: Renders a multi-choice list. The user selects zero or more items; the chosen set of labels is posted as the user's next message (comma-separated). Use when the agent asks the user to pick multiple options.

title.description: Card heading shown at the top.

body.description: Optional supporting text shown under the title. Markdown is NOT rendered.

label.description: Visible item text — also part of the post when the item is chosen.

description.description: Optional secondary line shown below the label.
